einzeiler: Behind the scenes of the Call Her Daddy memoir with Dave Portnoy.
kurzfassung: The hosts recap a lackluster episode of Dancing with the Stars and discuss recent pop culture news, including reactions to a tell-all memoir. The second half of the episode features an extended interview with Barstool Sports founder Dave Portnoy, who shares his unfiltered perspective on the historic Call Her Daddy contract dispute.
stichpunkte: The hosts interview Dave Portnoy about his side of the Call Her Daddy fallout.
Portnoy addresses specific claims made in Sophia Franklyn's recent memoir.
A recap of a Grammys-themed Dancing with the Stars episode and recent eliminations.
Discussion surrounding a controversial report about a Secret Lives of Mormon Wives star.
Alex Earl goes viral for posting a video reading the Call Her Daddy tell-all book.
A viral story about a newborn baby named Nixon Five after the New York Knicks.
Portnoy reflects on past and present internet feuds, including interactions with Bailey and Business Insider.

clips.text: The hosts emphasize that their daily show provides unfiltered, sisterly perspectives on pop culture that cannot be found anywhere else.
The guest arrived casually dressed in a Hawaiian shirt without any PR representation or assistants, drove himself, and remained entirely relaxed.
The guest notes that after more than twenty years running his company, this marks the very first time he has ever invited himself onto another podcast.

clips.hook: The anatomy of a massive missed opportunity
clips.text: The guest points out that staying with the company for just one more year would have ultimately yielded a payout comparable to Joe Rogan's massive contract.

clips.hook: Deserving a moment in the spotlight
clips.text: The guest acknowledges that despite past conflicts, the subject of the memoir deserves her current moment of attention and success.
